review:
**Verdict**: Approved with minor revisions. Fact-accurate, clear tone, locked constraints respected.

**Issues & Replacements**:

1. Image lines duplicate brand: Line 1 and Line 7 both say "Outline VPN".
   * Fix: Drop Line 7. Image text becomes clean: Line 6 `အခမဲ့`, Line 8 `Bot မှာ ရယူပါ`.

2. Caption sentence 1 phrasing stiff: `အခမဲ့ VPN Plan ရယူနိုင်ပါတယ်။`
   * Fix: Change to `အခမဲ့ စမ်းသုံးခွင့် ရယူနိုင်ပါတယ်။` Fits trial intent better than calling 300 MB "Plan".

3. Caption sentence 3 register mismatch: `စစ်ပြီးမှ ရယူပေးနော်။` shifts tone abruptly.
   * Fix: Change to `Bot ထဲမှာ အရင်စစ်ဆေးပြီးမှ ဝယ်ယူပေးပါနော်။` Smoother consumer phrasing.

**Score**: 8.5/10
